MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 您好 (nín hǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello (polite)
   B. I, me
   C. To be called
   D. You

2. What is the neutral tone? (1 mark)
   A. A light, short tone written without a mark
   B. A tone that falls sharply
   C. A tone that rises high
   D. A very loud tone

3. Which sentence means "And you?"? (1 mark)
   A. 你呢?
   B. 我叫小明。
   C. 早上好!
   D. 再见!

4. Which Chinese word means "this"? (1 mark)
   A. 这 zhè
   B. 妹妹 mèimei
   C. 那 nà
   D. 哥哥 gēge

5. What does 妹妹 (mèimei) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Younger sister
   B. Who
   C. Mother
   D. To have, there is

6. Fill the blank: 电视在____? (Where is the television?) (1 mark)
   A. 谁
   B. 几
   C. 什么
   D. 哪儿

7. Which room would you find a fridge in? (1 mark)
   A. 客厅 the living room
   B. 卧室 the bedroom
   C. 厕所 the toilet
   D. 厨房 the kitchen

8. Read the pinyin: jīntiān xīngqīsān. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today is Wednesday.
   B. On Friday, go to the mosque.
   C. On Saturday I rest at home.
   D. On Sunday, go to church.

9. Which word is pronounced xīngqīsān? (1 mark)
   A. 星期三
   B. 六
   C. 一
   D. 昨天

10. What does 你生日是几月几号? ask? (1 mark)
   A. When is your birthday?
   B. Where do you live?
   C. What is your name?
   D. What is your favourite food?

11. What does 玩 (wán) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Plate
   B. To play
   C. Candle
   D. To wish

12. Which Chinese word means "banana"? (1 mark)
   A. 早饭 zǎofàn
   B. 香蕉 xiāngjiāo
   C. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   D. 菠菜 bōcài

13. What does 手 (shǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Shoulder
   B. Head
   C. Foot
   D. Hand

14. What does 摸 (mō) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To laugh, to smile
   B. To brush teeth
   C. To cry
   D. To touch

15. What does 膝盖 (xīgài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To brush teeth
   B. To cry
   C. Hand
   D. Knee

16. What does 风 (fēng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Wind
   B. Not
   C. Cloud
   D. Flood

17. Which word is pronounced huāyuán? (1 mark)
   A. 窗户
   B. 花园
   C. 电视
   D. 沙发

18. Fill the blank: ____好! (Hello, teacher!) (1 mark)
   A. 老师
   B. 朋友
   C. 同学
   D. 爸爸

19. What does 叫 (jiào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello (polite)
   B. To be called
   C. Thank you
   D. Hello

20. Read the pinyin: lǎoshī hǎo! What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. My name is Xiaoming.
   B. Goodbye!
   C. Hello, teacher!
   D. And you?

21. What does 爸爸 (bàba) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Father
   B. Love
   C. Younger brother
   D. Is, am, are

22. Read the pinyin: chuáng zài wòshì. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The bathroom is beside the garden.
   B. The bed is in the bedroom.
   C. The garden is on the right of the house.
   D. Where is the television?

23. What does 四 (sì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Six
   C. Nine
   D. Four

24. What does 星期三 (xīngqīsān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today
   B. Tomorrow
   C. Wednesday
   D. One

25. What does 送 (sòng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Candle
   B. Happy
   C. To give (a gift)
   D. Which number, how many

26. What does 鸡肉 (jīròu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Chicken (meat)
   B. Fruit (as a group)
   C. Grapes
   D. Apple

27. Read the pinyin: fēng hěn dà. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today it rains.
   B. The sun is very big.
   C. The wind is very strong.
   D. Today there are clouds.

28. What does 雨 (yǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Snow
   B. Very
   C. Rain
   D. Small

29. Read the pinyin: huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   B. There is a bed in the bedroom.
   C. The garden is on the right of the house.
   D. Where is the sofa?

30. How many strokes does 好 have? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 6
   C. 4
   D. 9

31. How many strokes does the character 十 have? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 4

32. What does 有 (yǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Is, am, are
   B. Older sister
   C. Father
   D. To have, there is

33. Which word is pronounced gēge? (1 mark)
   A. 家
   B. 爱
   C. 谁
   D. 哥哥

34. What does 客厅 (kètīng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where
   B. Is at, is in
   C. Cat
   D. Living room

35. What does 星期天 (xīngqītiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. Five
   C. Today
   D. Seven

36. What does 饼 (bǐng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Flat bread
   B. Chicken (meat)
   C. Coffee
   D. Vegetables

37. What does 肉 (ròu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Meat
   B. Biscuits
   C. Banana
   D. Grapes

38. Which Chinese word means "sun"? (1 mark)
   A. 太阳 tàiyáng
   B. 天气 tiānqì
   C. 也 yě
   D. 小 xiǎo

39. How many strokes does 雨 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 6
   C. 11
   D. 8

40. What does 雪 (xuě) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cloud
   B. Snow
   C. Flood
   D. There is not

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." (2 marks)

42. Compare how Mandarin and Kiswahili name family members. Give two similarities or differences. (4 marks)

43. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 肉, 用 and 摸. (3 marks)

44. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see." (2 marks)

45. Give three tips for neat Chinese handwriting. (3 marks)

46. A picture shows a girl but the label says 儿子. Is the pair 对 or 错? Explain. (2 marks)

47. Give the Mandarin words for older brother, younger brother and younger sister, with pinyin. (3 marks)

48. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to drink tea." (2 marks)

49. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 椅子 and 谁. (2 marks)

50. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 来 and 笑. (2 marks)

51. Explain what tone, volume and vocal projection mean when reading aloud. (3 marks)

52. Write the Chinese for "I laugh" and "I cry" with pinyin. (2 marks)

53. Explain when we use 吃 and when we use 喝. (2 marks)

54. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 盘子, 爱 and 唱歌. (3 marks)

55. Put these pinyin words in alphabetical order: mǐfàn, bǐng, chá. (3 marks)

56. Why is a healthy plate made from several food groups? Give an example of a food from two groups. (3 marks)

57. Write a short dialogue of four lines in Chinese with pinyin: two friends greet each other and one says it is their birthday. (4 marks)

58. Write a five-sentence description of your family in Chinese with pinyin, using 这是 and 我家有. (5 marks)

59. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Tomorrow is Thursday." (3 marks)

60. Explain what stress is in reading aloud and give an example. (3 marks)

61. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We cut the cake." (2 marks)

62. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "For breakfast I eat bǐng." (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Hello (polite)
   您好 (nín hǎo) means hello (polite).

2. A — A light, short tone written without a mark
   The neutral tone is light and short, as in the second syllable of māma.

3. A — 你呢?
   你呢? (nǐ ne?) means "And you?".

4. A — 这 zhè
   这 (zhè) means this.

5. A — Younger sister
   妹妹 (mèimei) means younger sister.

6. D — 哪儿
   哪儿 asks where.

7. D — 厨房 the kitchen
   冰箱 is in the kitchen, 厨房.

8. A — Today is Wednesday.
   jīntiān xīngqīsān. is 今天星期三。, which means "Today is Wednesday.".

9. A — 星期三
   星期三 is pronounced xīngqīsān and means Wednesday.

10. A — When is your birthday?
   月 is month and 号 is the date.

11. B — To play
   玩 (wán) means to play.

12. B — 香蕉 xiāngjiāo
   香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) means banana.

13. D — Hand
   手 (shǒu) means hand.

14. D — To touch
   摸 (mō) means to touch.

15. D — Knee
   膝盖 (xīgài) means knee.

16. A — Wind
   风 (fēng) means wind.

17. B — 花园
   花园 is pronounced huāyuán and means garden.

18. A — 老师
   老师 is teacher.

19. B — To be called
   叫 (jiào) means to be called.

20. C — Hello, teacher!
   lǎoshī hǎo! is 老师好!, which means "Hello, teacher!".

21. A — Father
   爸爸 (bàba) means father.

22. B — The bed is in the bedroom.
   chuáng zài wòshì. is 床在卧室。, which means "The bed is in the bedroom.".

23. D — Four
   四 (sì) means four.

24. C — Wednesday
   星期三 (xīngqīsān) means Wednesday.

25. C — To give (a gift)
   送 (sòng) means to give (a gift).

26. A — Chicken (meat)
   鸡肉 (jīròu) means chicken (meat).

27. C — The wind is very strong.
   fēng hěn dà. is 风很大。, which means "The wind is very strong.".

28. C — Rain
   雨 (yǔ) means rain.

29. C — The garden is on the right of the house.
   huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian. is 花园在房子右边。, which means "The garden is on the right of the house.".

30. B — 6
   女 has 3 and 子 has 3.

31. B — 2
   十 has 横 and 竖.

32. D — To have, there is
   有 (yǒu) means to have, there is.

33. D — 哥哥
   哥哥 is pronounced gēge and means older brother.

34. D — Living room
   客厅 (kètīng) means living room.

35. A — Sunday
   星期天 (xīngqītiān) means Sunday.

36. A — Flat bread
   饼 (bǐng) means flat bread.

37. A — Meat
   肉 (ròu) means meat.

38. A — 太阳 tàiyáng
   太阳 (tàiyáng) means sun.

39. D — 8
   雨 has eight strokes.

40. B — Snow
   雪 (xuě) means snow.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Similar: both repeat a syllable in words for close family, such as baba and bàba, mama and māma. Different: Mandarin has different words for older and younger brothers and sisters, but Kiswahili uses kaka and dada for both.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 4.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: 肉: ròu, meat. 用: yòng, to use. 摸: mō, to touch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Keep characters the same size, keep strokes firm and straight, leave equal spaces, write in the right stroke order, do not join separate strokes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 错 (wrong). 儿子 means son, but the picture shows a girl.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying 错 and 1 mark for the reason.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: 哥哥 gēge, 弟弟 dìdi, 妹妹 mèimei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with pinyin.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 椅子: yǐzi, chair. 谁: shéi, who.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: 来: lái, to come. 笑: xiào, to laugh, to smile.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tone is the rise and fall of each syllable, volume is how loud you speak and projection is sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我笑 wǒ xiào; 我哭 wǒ kū.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: We use 吃 with foods to say eat, and we use 喝 with drinks to say drink.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verb.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: 盘子: pánzi, plate. 爱: ài, love. 唱歌: chànggē, to sing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: bǐng, chá, mǐfàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct position.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Each group helps the body in a different way. For example rice gives energy and spinach gives vitamins.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 2 marks for examples.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好! nǐ hǎo! A: 今天是我的生日。 jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì. B: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line, with pinyin.

58. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我家有五口人。这是我爸爸。这是我妈妈。这是我哥哥。这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba. zhè shì wǒ māma. zhè shì wǒ gēge. zhè shì wǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence, with pinyin and correct tones.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: 明天是星期四。 míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stress means saying an important word a little stronger. For example in 我们切蛋糕, you may stress 蛋糕 to show what we cut. It does not change the tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for the tone note.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我们切蛋糕。 wǒmen qiē dàngāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我早饭吃饼。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.
